verdict.rationale: Whether user data is used for AI training is a fair privacy question for a hosted chat product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a no-training policy, or any data-use commitment about model training. Self-hosting and export tools are adjacent data-control features and do not count as this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
